turns.query: For FEDFUND accession 0002071691-25-004249 on 2025-10-31, compare its reported seven-day share-class yields with the New York Fed overnight SOFR effective on the same date. Report the class count, total class net assets, series gross yield, equal-class mean net yield and class-net-asset-weighted mean net yield. Report the Institutional class asset share and identify the unique lowest-net-yield class with its net yield. Then report SOFR and compare the series gross yield and the asset-weighted class net yield with it. Explain the weighting result and the limits of comparing the fund yields with SOFR.
